
'''Wakamiya Shrine''' (若宮神社, Wakamiya Jinja) refers to various {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines}} located across Japan.
Most notably [[Wakamiya Shrine (Shimonoseki)]]

== Kanto Region ==
* {{ill|Wakamiya Shrine (Hino, Takahata)|ja|若宮神社 (日野市高畑)}} - Located in {{ill|Hino, Tokyo|en|Hino, Tokyo|qid=Q236197|lt=Hino City}}, Tokyo, Takahata.
